messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] standard errors from variance component ratios
parts:
On 12/02/16 13:33, Bruno da Costa Perez wrote:
> Is it possible calculate standard errors for "variance component"
> ratios using R-INLA?
> (for ex. the heritability)
>
You can use posterior samples to do that, see inla.hyperpar.sample()

> If so, how could I code it?
> If not, is there any other commonly used strategy to overcome this?

fit you model considering
inla(..., control.compute=list(config=TRUE))
them sample from the posterior and compute what you want.

Elias
